MenuReady

Privacy Policy

Effective September 30, 2026

MenuReady provides visual QR menus, business websites and Google Business Profile setup services. This policy explains how we handle information submitted through our website, Meta lead forms, email and other business inquiries.

Information we collect

We may collect your name, business name, email address, city, business type, current menu information, service interests and any files or details you choose to send us.

How we use information

We use this information to respond to inquiries, prepare quotes, create requested previews, provide purchased services and communicate about an active project. We do not sell personal information.

Service providers

Information may be processed by service providers we use to operate MenuReady, including Meta for lead forms and social messaging, Vercel for website hosting, and our email provider. These providers handle information under their own privacy terms.

Data retention and choices

We keep inquiry and project information only as long as reasonably necessary for follow-up, service delivery, recordkeeping and legal obligations. You may request access, correction or deletion of your information by contacting us.

Contact

For privacy questions or requests, email contact@menureadynv.com.
